The '''Spacetrek Collective''' is a non-profit international scientific organization jointly established by various nations and organizations of [[Solaris-3]]. It oversees the research, development, and construction work in [[Lahai-Roi]]. They built the [[Spacetrek Collective Research Institute|Research Institute]], [[Startorch Academy]], [[Starward Riseway]] in the vast space beneath the frostlands. Its core mission is the study of the [[Exostrider]] for the purposes of advancing and re-instigating space travel technology.

==History==
Formed by the [[Pioneer Association]]'s head of states, the Spacetrek Collective was initially named the Polar Collective. After a mutual agreement amongst multiple nations, the Polar Collective established a formal alliance with the [[Roya Tribe]] and the Association was forbidden from carrying out any activities that would harm or disrupt Royan society.
